evidence_item_name: Original Hospital Payment Receipt and Bill Breakdown
evidence_item_name_original: Kuitansi Asli Pembayaran Rumah Sakit dan Rincian Biaya
description: Official payment receipt stamped by hospital cashier with detailed breakdown of room charges, doctor consultations, lab tests, medications, and surgical consumables.
accepted_formats: High-resolution digital scan for eAZy Connect preliminary review
special_conditions: Duplicate or provisional receipts not accepted without official hospital confirmation seal.

evidence_item_name: Medical Resume Signed by Treating Physician
evidence_item_name_original: Resume Medis Pasien yang Ditandatangani Dokter yang Merawat
description: Clinical summary document specifying diagnosis (ICD-10 code), symptom onset date, clinical history, diagnostic findings, medical interventions performed, and doctor registration number (SIP/IDI).
accepted_formats: Digital hospital electronic medical record certified printout
special_conditions: Must explicitly state the cause of condition to verify policy exclusion criteria.
